name: Aspect of the Hope Devourer
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 9, death mage 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

Your presence saps the hope and joy from your enemies. A creature that fails a save against this spell paralyzed by unbearable despair and hopelessness. A flying creature may continue to hover while paralyzed by this effect and if they cannot hover, they immediately land but are otherwise paralyzed. These creatures are paralyzed for the duration of the spell.

Each round on its turn, a target of this spell may attempt a new saving throw to end the effect; this is a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. A creature that recovers from this spell early after being affected by it for at least 1 round takes 1d6 points of Wisdom drain and is hopeless for 1d4 rounds. A creature that makes the initial save to resist this spell is merely hopeless for 1 round.
